P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or human anchor present; the page relies entirely on typography and abstract graphics.

P05.rationale: The layout contains no case studies with client portraits; it consists of a single headline section and a summary statement.

P07.rationale: A specific data point (40%) is highlighted to serve as social proof, though it lacks the full apparatus of a press wall or review grid found in references.

P10.rationale: The page features oversized decorative typographic elements, specifically the large '13' numeral and the massive headline text acting as visual anchors.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisation is present in the form of a specific percentage (40%) and a comparative chart showing revenue potential versus realized revenue.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks, columns, and integrated graphics without sparse gaps.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present in the form of a dark blue gradient and subtle grain/noise effect throughout the page.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos used on this page to require treatment or text readability checks; the design relies on solid color backgrounds.

P16.rationale: A device/product mockup is shown in the reference images (laptop and phones), but it is absent from our generated page which uses abstract graphics instead.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists of specific data charts and typographic elements rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There are no large empty regions with dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content columns and text blocks.

N10.rationale: Text sits on solid color backgrounds or distinct white boxes rather than busy photos without scrim, ensuring high readability.
